svg.text: One writer thread, vertices only, both protocols

g.text: The simple variant keeps the protocol matrix but drops the edges: one writer thread, vertices only.
numOfThreads = 1, numOfUsers = 1000, numOfPhotos = 10 - no friendships, no likes, no metrics dump
The pool holds exactly one thread, so this measures a single client stream rather than contention.
Executors.newFixedThreadPool(numOfThreads); the task opens its own DatabaseWrapper and closes it at the end
The watcher loop is tighter here, and it does not guard the count calls - a failure there fails the test.
while (!executor.isTerminated()) { countUsers(); countPhotos(); sleep 2s } (no try/catch, unlike the full test)
Both totals must be exact on each protocol arm, which is what makes this the quickest regression signal.
